model_settings.value: Four whole-brain random-effects ANOVAs were conducted; F-maps were thresholded at p<0.01 with cluster-size thresholds of 16 voxels for anger maps and 15 voxels for happy maps, using Monte Carlo simulation for cluster-level multiple-comparisons correction at p<0.05 with 1,000 simulations.

name.value: adapted MRI version of the Anger Articulated Thoughts during Simulated Situations (ATSS) paradigm

spans.text: In the current study an adapted MRI version of the Anger Articulated Thoughts during Simulated Situations (ATSS) paradigm  was utilized in order to elicit anger and happy provocation and regulation.

description.value: Participants were presented with audiotaped happy, neutral, and anger situations in engagement and distraction conditions.
